newsitem.title: USA: Icahn nominates slate for RJR Nabisco board.
newsitem.headline: Icahn nominates slate for RJR Nabisco board.

text.p: Corporate investor Carl Icahn said Monday that he has nominated a slate of directors to the board of RJR Nabisco Holdings Inc.
The slate will be led by Thomas Rattigan, former chairman of G. Heileman Brewing Co, according to a statement from Icahn's High River Limited Partnership.
According to a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, Rattigan would become chief executive officer if the board slate were elected.

The slate also includes DeWitt Bowman, Ivan Burns, Seymour Fleigel, Paul Gibson, Keith Gollust, Robert Lawler, Carlos Resendez, Robert Slater and Jack Wasserman. In addition, Harold First and Miles Bender were designated as alternate members to the Rattigan slate.
The nominees will be up for election at RJR's 1997 annual stockholders meeting. RJR had set a Nov. 5 deadline for the nomination of board slates.

Last year, Ichan teamed up with investor Bennett LeBow in an unsuccessful bid to unseat the RJR board and install a new booard committed to an immediate spinoff of RJR's 80 percent-owned Nabisco Holdings Corp.
RJR has said that it wants to spin off the food business from its tobacco operations, but this is not the appropriate time to split up the company.
Icahn and LeBow split up after their defeat last year, although both said they would continue to individually press for an immediate spinoff.
